items.name: Parse Tree
items.depicts: A large symmetrical three-tier tree with a framed yellow root node, orange and green intermediate nodes, and four yellow-rimmed dark-navy leaf boxes linked by stepped diagonal edges.

items.name: Pruned Expression
items.depicts: A compact, asymmetric tree of borderless blocks with a yellow root branching to orange and green children, and only the left branch splitting further into pale-yellow and light-blue leaves.

items.name: Lexeme Tray
items.depicts: A dark-navy rectangular tray holding four evenly spaced vertical coloured tiles in yellow, green, light blue, and coral.

items.name: Constant Pool
items.depicts: A lavender-bordered dark-navy box containing four left-aligned horizontal bars of varying lengths, three steel blue and one highlighted in yellow.

items.name: Maximal Muncher
items.depicts: A yellow-bordered dark-navy window framing three distinct coloured rectangles in green, orange, and light blue of increasing widths from left to right.

items.name: Control-Flow Fork
items.depicts: A yellow-framed dark box at the top with stepped lavender paths diverging downward to a green-framed box on the left and a coral-framed box on the right.

items.name: Gilded Nodelet
items.depicts: A tiny dark-navy rectangular frame enclosing a bright yellow core, flanked by two pale-yellow single-pixel side tabs like stubby wings.

items.name: Opcode Tile
items.depicts: A compact dark-navy horizontal tile containing a narrow yellow bar on the left and a wider green square on the right, resembling an opcode-and-operand pair.
